anchor:
- id: artifact-quality-domain-handoff
    prompt: "The UI concept image exists. Continue."
    expected_skills: [artifact-quality]
    optional_skills: [product-ui-design]
    required_behaviors:
      - use the domain specialist to define what counts as a good design artifact
      - use artifact-quality to govern inspect classify revise and reinspect convergence
      - preserve the distinction between observed product capability and proposed UX
      - do not load unrelated specialists merely because they could be useful
insertion:
- id: design-mechanics-semantic-before-values
    prompt: "Turn this approved product UI direction into a reusable color and component system."
    expected_skills: [design-mechanics]
    optional_skills: [product-ui-design]
    required_behaviors:
      - preserve the approved product and screen contract before selecting implementation primitives
      - define semantic color and surface roles before assigning concrete values
      - specify material interaction states including focus and disabled behavior
      - treat component libraries as mechanics references rather than aesthetic authority
      - keep product-specific hierarchy distinct from library defaults

  - id: design-mechanics-targeted-reference
    prompt: "I need the correct keyboard, focus, and state behavior for this custom composite control."
    expected_skills: [design-mechanics]
    required_behaviors:
      - identify the concrete interaction-mechanics gap before retrieving reference material
      - prefer the smallest sufficient authoritative primitive or accessibility reference
      - distinguish normative behavior from one example composition
      - translate retrieved mechanics into the product control without copying unrelated layout or styling

  - id: design-mechanics-anti-homogenization
    prompt: "Use shadcn, Radix, and Tailwind knowledge to finish the mechanics of this distinctive product workspace."
    expected_skills: [design-mechanics]
    optional_skills: [product-ui-design]
    required_behaviors:
      - preserve the product-derived spatial model and domain-specific controls
      - use upstream libraries for component state accessibility token and composition mechanics
      - do not replace the workspace with a generic SaaS dashboard or library example
      - challenge a result whose structure could plausibly belong to any generic SaaS product
      - preserve semantic product tokens rather than adopting library defaults wholesale
